slug: 2025-06-30 Zimbabwe's Cyber and Data Protection Act - Overview

facts.fact: Michalsons describes the Cyber and Data Protection Act, 2021 as Zimbabwe's main data protection law applying to all public and private organisations; dated by publication.
Michalsons states the Act is enforced by POTRAZ, which also maintains a public register of automated data processing; dated by publication.
